query: SELECT ar.id, ar.cliente, ar.valorLiquido, ar.valorRecebidoLiquido, CAST(ar.valorLiquido AS DECIMAL(18,2)) - CAST(COALESCE(ar.valorRecebidoLiquido, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) as calc_valor FROM accounts_receivable ar WHERE ar.estado = 'RECEBIDO' AND ar.liquidacaoData >= '2026-05-25' AND DATEDIFF(ar.liquidacaoData, ar.vencimentoData) >= 3 LIMIT 5;
